_comment: Custom PTDL_v2 egg for Garry's Mod. Generated for mixutin.
name: Garry's Mod Ultimate
author: mixutin@users.noreply.github.com
description: Feature-rich Garry's Mod egg with SteamCMD install/update, stable/x86-64/dev/prerelease branches, Workshop collections, safe generated panel config, GSLT, RCON, FastDL/loading URL, P2P, Lua refresh control, validation and custom startup arguments.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME=/mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps

cd /tmp
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd

cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

CMD=(
  ./steamcmd.sh
  +force_install_dir /mnt/server
  +login anonymous
  +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID:-4020}"
)

if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ]]; then
  CMD+=( -beta "$SRCDS_BETAID" )
fi

CMD+=( validate +quit )

"${CMD[@]}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
[[ -f linux32/steamclient.so ]] && cp -f linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
[[ -f linux64/steamclient.so ]] && cp -f linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

mkdir -p /mnt/server/pterodactyl /mnt/server/garrysmod/cfg /mnt/server/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server

cat > /mnt/server/pterodactyl/start.sh <<'STARTSCRIPT'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

cd "${HOME:-/home/container}"
SERVER_ROOT="$(pwd)"
PORT="${1:-${SERVER_PORT:-27015}}"

log() {
  printf '[gmod-egg] %s\n' "$*"
}

sync_steamclient() {
  mkdir -p "$SERVER_ROOT/.steam/sdk32" "$SERVER_ROOT/.steam/sdk64"
  if [[ -f "$SERVER_ROOT/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so" ]]; then
    cp -f "$SERVER_ROOT/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so" "$SERVER_ROOT/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
  fi
  if [[ -f "$SERVER_ROOT/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so" ]]; then
    cp -f "$SERVER_ROOT/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so" "$SERVER_ROOT/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"
  fi
}

steam_update() {
  [[ "${GMOD_AUTO_UPDATE:-1}" == "1" ]] || return 0
  [[ -x "$SERVER_ROOT/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ]] || {
    log "SteamCMD is missing; skipping automatic update."
    return 0
  }

  local -a cmd
  cmd=(
    "$SERVER_ROOT/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh"
    +force_install_dir "$SERVER_ROOT"
    +login anonymous
    +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID:-4020}"
  )

  if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ]]; then
    cmd+=( -beta "$SRCDS_BETAID" )
  fi

  if [[ "${VALIDATE_FILES:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    cmd+=( validate )
  fi

  cmd+=( +quit )

  log "Checking Garry's Mod server files for updates..."
  "${cmd[@]}"
  sync_steamclient
}

cfg_escape() {
  local value="${1:-}"
  value="${value//$'\r'/}"
  value="${value//$'\n'/ }"
  value="${value//\\/\\\\}"
  value="${value//\"/\\\"}"
  printf '%s' "$value"
}

write_panel_cfg() {
  mkdir -p "$SERVER_ROOT/garrysmod/cfg"

  local hostname password rcon location fastdl loading
  hostname="$(cfg_escape "${SERVER_NAME:-Pterodactyl GMod}")"
  password="$(cfg_escape "${SERVER_PASSWORD:-}")"
  rcon="$(cfg_escape "${RCON_PASSWORD:-}")"
  location="$(cfg_escape "${SERVER_LOCATION:-eu}")"
  fastdl="$(cfg_escape "${FASTDL_URL:-}")"
  loading="$(cfg_escape "${LOADING_URL:-}")"

  cat > "$SERVER_ROOT/garrysmod/cfg/pterodactyl.cfg" <<CFG
// Generated by the Pterodactyl Garry's Mod Ultimate egg on every start.
// Put your own persistent settings in garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg.
hostname "${hostname}"
sv_password "${password}"
rcon_password "${rcon}"
sv_location "${location}"
hide_server "${HIDE_SERVER:-0}"
sv_lan "${SV_LAN:-0}"
host_workshop_autoupdate "${WORKSHOP_AUTO_UPDATE:-1}"
sv_downloadurl "${fastdl}"
sv_loadingurl "${loading}"
exec banned_ip.cfg
exec banned_user.cfg
CFG
}

steam_update
write_panel_cfg
sync_steamclient

BIN="${SERVER_BINARY:-srcds_run}"
if [[ ! -x "$SERVER_ROOT/$BIN" ]]; then
  if [[ "$BIN" == "srcds_run_x64" && -x "$SERVER_ROOT/srcds_run" ]]; then
    log "srcds_run_x64 was requested but is unavailable; falling back to srcds_run."
    BIN="srcds_run"
  else
    log "Server binary '$BIN' does not exist or is not executable."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

ARGS=(
  -game garrysmod
  -console
  -port "$PORT"
  +ip 0.0.0.0
  -strictportbind
  -norestart
  +maxplayers "${MAX_PLAYERS:-32}"
  -tickrate "${TICKRATE:-33}"
  +exec pterodactyl.cfg
  +gamemode "${GAMEMODE:-sandbox}"
  +host_workshop_autoupdate "${WORKSHOP_AUTO_UPDATE:-1}"
)

if [[ -n "${WORKSHOP_ID:-}" ]]; then
  ARGS+=( +host_workshop_collection "$WORKSHOP_ID" )
fi

if [[ -n "${STEAM_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  ARGS+=( +sv_setsteamaccount "$STEAM_TOKEN" )
fi

if [[ "${LUA_REFRESH:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
  ARGS+=( -disableluarefresh )
fi

if [[ "${P2P_MODE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
  ARGS+=( -p2p )
fi

ARGS+=( +map "${SRCDS_MAP:-gm_flatgrass}" )

if [[ -n "${CUSTOM_ARGS:-}" ]]; then
  read -r -a EXTRA_ARGS <<< "$CUSTOM_ARGS"
  ARGS+=( "${EXTRA_ARGS[@]}" )
fi

log "Starting Garry's Mod with $BIN"
exec "$SERVER_ROOT/$BIN" "${ARGS[@]}"
STARTSCRIPT

chmod +x /mnt/server/pterodactyl/start.sh

if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg ]]; then
  cat > /mnt/server/garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg <<'CFG'
// Persistent custom Garry's Mod server configuration.
// Panel-managed values are written to pterodactyl.cfg at every start.

sv_region "255"
sv_max_queries_sec_global "30000"
sv_max_queries_window "45"
sv_max_queries_sec "5"

sbox_maxprops "100"
sbox_maxragdolls "5"
sbox_maxnpcs "10"
sbox_maxballoons "10"
sbox_maxeffects "10"
sbox_maxdynamite "10"
sbox_maxlamps "10"
sbox_maxthrusters "10"
sbox_maxwheels "10"
sbox_maxhoverballs "10"
sbox_maxvehicles "20"
sbox_maxbuttons "10"
sbox_maxsents "20"
sbox_maxemitters "5"

sv_minrate "75000"
sv_maxrate "0"
gmod_physiterations "2"
net_splitpacket_maxrate "45000"
decalfrequency "12"
CFG
fi

if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/garrysmod/cfg/srcds_workshop_ids.txt ]]; then
  cat > /mnt/server/garrysmod/cfg/srcds_workshop_ids.txt <<'CFG'
"pterodactyl_workshop_addons"
{
}
CFG
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Garry's Mod installation complete."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Source AppID
variables.description: Steam application ID for the Garry's Mod Dedicated Server. Do not change this.

variables.name: Runtime Image Auto Update
variables.description: Disabled so the egg's branch-aware updater handles SteamCMD updates exactly once.

variables.name: Steam Branch
variables.description: Steam branch to install/update. Use public for stable, x86-64 for the 64-bit branch, dev for development, or prerelease for pre-release.

variables.name: Server Binary
variables.description: Executable to launch. Use srcds_run for normal 32-bit hosting or srcds_run_x64 with the x86-64 branch.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Check Steam for Garry's Mod server updates every time the server starts. This egg manages updates itself so beta branch changes are respected.

variables.name: Validate Files On Update
variables.description: Run SteamCMD validate during startup updates. Useful for repairs, but slower.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map loaded at startup.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Gamemode loaded at startup, for example sandbox, darkrp, terrortown, or your custom gamemode folder name.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum player slots.

variables.name: Tickrate
variables.description: Source engine tickrate. 33 is a balanced default; higher values cost more CPU.

variables.name: Steam Game Login Token
variables.description: Optional GSLT used for public Steam server listing.

variables.name: Workshop Collection ID
variables.description: Optional public or unlisted Steam Workshop collection ID downloaded and mounted by the server.

variables.name: Workshop Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically update mounted Workshop content on server start.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Hostname shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional join password. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Optional RCON password. Use a strong value if remote console is enabled.

variables.name: Server Location
variables.description: Server browser location flag code, such as fi, eu, gb, or us.

variables.name: Hide From Server Browser
variables.description: Set to 1 to hide the server from the public server browser.

variables.name: LAN Only
variables.description: Set to 1 for LAN-only hosting.

variables.name: Lua Refresh
variables.description: Set to 1 to enable Lua refresh. Default 0 passes -disableluarefresh for predictable production behavior.

variables.name: Peer-to-Peer Mode
variables.description: Enable Garry's Mod dedicated-server P2P mode.

variables.name: FastDL URL
variables.description: Optional sv_downloadurl for FastDL.

variables.name: Loading Screen URL
variables.description: Optional sv_loadingurl.

variables.name: Custom Startup Arguments
variables.description: Optional extra SRCDS arguments appended without shell eval. Example: -nohltv +con_logfile console.log
